digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / reconciler / CLI registry / code-review kernel
propositions: Five recovered implementation decisions (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed derisk research mapping architectural intent, hard-won behavior, and implementation-critical ambiguities before becoming tracked stories.

RP-02 owns ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary: durable tombstone is the retirement intent, recovery removes live pair only when tombstone/forward/reverse identities exactly agree, repeat is a no-op, ambiguity aborts.

RP-03 establishes singular physical-retry ownership (max 3 invocations / 15s sleep per atomic postcondition), authoritative Jira rate scopes, one observe-replan cycle, and scoped finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive exhausted outcomes across ≥2 tickets) before dependent TicketPlan orchestration.

RP-04 supplies centralized resolved operation authority (explicit > environment > project > user > default precedence, per-operation snapshot, separate secret/provider boundary) and explicit CLI-over-environment tracker precedence correction, malformed-config fail-closed behavior, and removal of Cloud adapter-local DIG fallback.

RP-05 normalizes canonical help for all 75 visible top-level commands (54 package-help-backed + 21 intercepted advanced verbs) before RP-04 operation-snapshot composition, with exact-alias canonical reuse and bridge-compatibility shim help naming replacements.

RP-06 applies effective applicability reversal and authored explicit budget enforcement to code-review plan selection; inverted behavior enumerates unconditional exactly-once Round-A fan-in, disabled criteria still scheduled, split-brain routing divergence, failed/cancelled checkpoints persisted as success, and unified failure scope treatment.
